name: companion-bot
description: A furry 3D companion for your web app: a drop-in <companion-bot> element with moods and expressions, plus a customizer users can restyle it with.

interface.shortDescription: A furry 3D companion and customizer for your web app.
interface.longDescription: A drop-in <companion-bot> web component: a plush 3D bot that blinks, follows the pointer, hops when clicked and mirrors your app's mood, with a customizer for fur, face, eyes, nose and 14 glasses frames. Three.js on WebGPU with WebGL fallbacks; plain ES modules, no build step.
